name: @aurelia/devtools
description: A browser extension for debugging Aurelia 1 and 2 applications.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:html && npm run typecheck
scripts.start: rimraf dist && concurrently "vite build --watch" "vite build --watch --mode hook"
scripts.build: rimraf dist && vite build && vite build --mode hook
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:e2e:debug: npm run build && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --debug
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build && npx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --ui
